# Onepage

API for enriching user and company data, providing endpoints for token validation and generic search.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/onepage/.

## Actions

- **Search input post request** (read-only): The searchinput endpoint allows users to perform a search query within the onepage platform.
- **Token details request** (read-only): Retrieves detailed information about a specific token in the onepage system.
